atoms.statement: A completed fullFaceDescriptions call has a recorded elapsed time.
The comment reports a longer first forward pass on some machines.

citations.quote: This unfortunately causes the first forward pass of MTCNN to be much longer on certain machines.

atoms.statement: The commenter explicitly calls GPU texture allocation a wild guess and states uncertainty.

citations.quote: I am not sure where this inital delay comes from (maybe due to allocating textures of certain sizes on the GPU; just a wild guess; I am not that familar with WebGL for GPGPU).

candidates.label: Poor Performance
candidates.reason: A completed timed operation plus the reported unusually long first pass supports reported slowness; the numeric timing alone is not a learned threshold.

candidates.label: WebGL Limits
candidates.reason: The source supplies a qualified GPU allocation hypothesis, not an established resource limit causing this delay.
candidates.missing_evidence: Evidence identifying a concrete WebGL limit and connecting it to the delay; a patch is not inherently required.

candidates.label: Incorrect Code Logic
candidates.reason: An initial delay is compatible with several mechanisms; these observations identify no erroneous code path.
candidates.missing_evidence: Evidence distinguishing a code logic defect from a backend/resource constraint or expected initialization cost.

atoms.statement: The command terminates with exit code 7.

citations.quote: error Command failed with exit code 7

atoms.statement: The trace records an abort and out-of-memory error during WebAssembly instantiation.

citations.quote: RuntimeError: abort(RangeError: WebAssembly Instantiation: Out of memory: wasm memory).

candidates.label: Crash
candidates.reason: An abort and nonzero process termination conditionally support unexpected termination. This does not establish priority over initialization failure.

candidates.label: Build & Initialization Failure
candidates.reason: Instantiation appears in the trace, but the quoted error alone does not establish the application's initialization phase.
candidates.missing_evidence: Execution context locating the failure in initialization versus an already running application.

candidates.label: Poor Performance
candidates.reason: Memory exhaustion is recorded together with termination. The applicable symptom boundary requires comparison with the execution failure.
candidates.missing_evidence: Evidence of the execution phase and whether abnormal resource use or the resulting termination is the observed behavior being classified.

candidates.label: Incorrect Code Logic
candidates.reason: Out of memory reports the failure condition; it does not identify the code mechanism that caused allocation failure.
candidates.missing_evidence: Evidence linking the allocation failure to a specific erroneous implementation, rather than an environment/resource constraint.
